title: Promotional Window Order for a Directed Payment — Crestline Credit Card
content:
When a Crestline Credit Card cardholder directs today's payment to a deferred-interest plan, the order the amount available goes in follows the rule for a deferred-interest plan's last 2 billing cycles, read here as a period ending no more than 61 days after today: when another deferred-interest plan with a recorded balance is in that window, its recorded balance is served first and only the rest reaches the named plan; when the named plan itself is in that window, the minimum still unpaid also goes to it, so the amount available plus that minimum reaches it; otherwise the whole amount available reaches the named plan.

## Terms

- **In the window:** the plan's period ends today or later and no more than 61 days after today; this applies to a 6-, 12- or 18-month deferred-interest plan alike.
- **Recorded balance:** purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for the plan and less the merchandise credits carrying its ticket number.
- **Amount available:** today's payments after the latest statement's minimum still unpaid, that statement's fees still owed and the deferred interest of a plan ended since it closed.
- **Minimum still unpaid:** the latest statement's minimum less the payments made toward it before today, less any of them returned.

## Decision table

| Situation on the day | Reaches the named plan |
|---|---|
| one or more other deferred-interest plans with a recorded balance end within 61 days | the amount available less their recorded balances, not below zero |
| no such other plan; the named plan itself ends within 61 days | the amount available plus the minimum still unpaid |
| neither | the whole amount available |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Amount available 374.90 USD; a 6-month plan with a recorded balance of 150.00 USD ends in 40 days: 224.90 USD reaches the named plan.
- The same, but that 6-month plan ends in 62 days: outside the window; 374.90 USD reaches the named plan.
- No other plan in the window; the named plan ends in 30 days; minimum still unpaid 62.00 USD: 436.90 USD reaches it.
